adjudication.rationale: Looking at the diff in app/assets/javascripts/discourse/models/group.js, the `removeMember` function (lines 41-49) and `addMembers` function (lines 51-59) both call `self.findMembers()` in their `.then()` callbacks but don't return the result. The `findMembers()` method returns a promise (line 27 shows `return Discourse.ajax(...)`). By not returning `self.findMembers()` from the fulfillment callbacks, the outer promise resolves immediately when the add/remove API call completes, before the member list refresh finishes. If `findMembers()` fails, that error would be silently swallowed. This is a real bug - the promise chain is broken, potentially leaving stale UI state if the refresh fails.
